title: Break it down
body: A task you can finish in under an hour is easier to start than one called “revise everything”.

title: Set a due date
body: A date turns a wish into a plan. Sort by it every morning.

title: Finish before you add
body: If your list keeps growing, close one task before writing a new one.

title: Review weekly
body: Once a week, delete what no longer matters. A short list is a list you trust.
